sources.title: Running Home Assistant Control with a 0.5B Model? I Got the Full ...
sources.snippet: Hey Makers! 👋 I've been working on a pretty interesting challenge: getting a tiny 0.5B parameter LLM to reliably control Home Assistant devices. Spoiler alert—it actually works, and it's fast. Let me walk you through the journey, the failures, and what finally clicked.
